title: Chapter 209 Entering The Altar
content:
Chapter 209 Entering The Altar

Although his face was red to his ears, Wang Shuo felt very comfortable and didn't feel embarrassed at once!

"My name is Wang Shuo, from Wana Village, you..."

Wang Shuo wanted to say something, but was interrupted by Gong Zheng who walked out of the passage.

"Lord!"

A rough voice interrupted the peaceful atmosphere.

Wang Shuo felt unhappy, but business was important.

Standing up, Wang Shuo walked forward more than ten steps and came to a corner of a dead flower bed.

"Have you done everything?" Wang Shuo asked in a low voice.

"This is what was searched from the two people, and the people have been dealt with!" Gong Zheng also said in a low voice, and made a gesture of wiping his neck.

Wang Shuo didn't know why the two of them were sneaking around at this time.

Nodding, Wang Shuo took over 6 backpacks.

Each backpack, that is, a storage bag, is only the size of a palm.

Counted the supplies inside.

[Cloud Ladder Blueprint +1, Cloud-Stepping Boots +1, Blood-Recovering Pill Formula +1]

There is a brocade box. After Wang Shuo opened it, there were 8 Earth-Emperor Fruits inside.

There are also some other items, which are not very valuable.

[Cloud-Stepping Boots: Gold Equipment, Agility +20, Movement Speed +20%, Durability 200/200]

I don’t know if this pair of shoes was dropped by Dr. Jia.

Wang Shuo looked at the crocodile leather boots on his feet and felt a little disgusted.

After putting on the new shoes, Wang Shuo felt that he could walk briskly.

“Let’s go, rest for a while and replenish some energy.”

Wang Shuo patted Gong Zheng on the shoulder with a smile on his face, and gave Gong Zheng an Earth-Emperor Fruit by the way.

Wang Shuo returned to the altar and did not go to talk to Ye Xueer again, but concentrated on studying his side quests and the map of the Dragon King’s Underground Palace.

It was found that only this altar had not been explored.

This made Wang Shuo feel a little uneasy, because the completion rate of the side quest was only 55%.

Wang Shuo frowned, and now he could only bite the bullet and explore the altar.

He looked at the time. It was already past 7pm, but there were still a few hours before dark.

Earlier, Shi Lisha said that the nights here were very short, and it would be dark around 11 o'clock.

Wang Shuo immediately gathered everyone and planned to step onto the altar.

Everyone was full and their health and physical strength had recovered to their peak.

Wang Shuo stepped into the light circle and felt a chill all over his body.

He walked forward a few meters and stepped onto the altar.

The soul-devouring and bone-destroying ghost howling sounded like crying and complaining, which made Wang Shuo tremble in his heart.

Standing outside the altar, he could not see the situation inside the altar at all.

At this time, Wang Shuo saw the scene in front of him clearly.

In the middle of the altar with a radius of about 100 meters, a man was tied in the middle by dozens of black chains, and the ends of the chains were buried around the altar.

The man wore a crown, looked haggard, his eyes were empty and his gaze was distracted.

Seeing someone step into the altar, he remained motionless, like a wooden sculpture!

Wang Shuo took a closer look and was horrified. This man...

If this man is not the Black Dragon King, who else could it be?

He vaguely remembered that in the first scene animation, the man with sharp eyes and extraordinary heroic spirit exuded an invincible domineering aura.

And in front of him was just a destitute old man with a dead heart and dying old age.

He was surrounded by a strong and insoluble death aura. Strangely, above the neck, he was not invaded by the death aura.

"Black Dragon King?" Wang Shuo took a step forward with courage and called softly.

Wang Shuo didn't know what to do at this time!

Talk to him first to see if it would trigger any new effects.

The Black Dragon King did not respond.

Wang Shuo called a few more times.

After a while, the Black Dragon King's eyes gradually became clear.

It was as if his soul had returned to its place!

"Who are you? Why are you here?" The Black Dragon King's dry throat squeezed out a low and hoarse voice.

Wang Shuo was very puzzled. After thousands of years, the Black Dragon King was still alive and had not been transformed into an undead.

At this moment, something strange happened suddenly, and countless death energy rushed towards the top of the Black Dragon King's head.

"Ah!"

The Black Dragon King screamed, and his cold face kept twisting, obviously trying his best to endure.
